title: 2007 Firestone–West paper on the Younger Dryas impact

tellings.quote: Well, then in 2007, Richard Firestone and Allan West and a number of others came out with a paper. George Howard came out with a paper proposing exactly that.

plain: In 2007, a paper by the scientists Richard Firestone, Allen West, George Howard and others proposed that a cosmic impact set off the Younger Dryas, a sudden return to ice-age cold near the end of the last ice age. The researcher Randall Carlson describes it on the show as a paper "proposing exactly that," the impact idea he had been arguing for himself.
